description: This source file defines a Swift class `TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer` that manages text-to-speech synthesis using AVFoundation's AVSpeechSynthesizer. It provides methods to speak text asynchronously with timeout handling, stop speech, and manage speech delegate callbacks.

classes.name: TalkSystemSpeechSynthesizer
classes.description: A singleton class managing text-to-speech synthesis operations, including speaking text with optional language and callback, stopping ongoing speech, and handling timeouts.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops ongoing speech and cancels timeout watchdog.

methods.name: speak
methods.description: Speaks a given text asynchronously, with optional language parameter and start callback, implementing a timeout watchdog.

methods.name: watchdogTimeoutSeconds
methods.description: Calculates a timeout duration based on text length and language for speech synthesis.

methods.name: matchesCurrentUtterance
methods.description: Checks if a given utterance ID matches the current utterance being spoken.

methods.name: handleFinish
methods.description: Handles the completion of speech, either normally or via cancellation/error.

methods.name: finishCurrent
methods.description: Resets current utterance state and resumes continuation with success or error.
